t: Contains all the decorating essentials needed for an excellent finish on both large surfaces and smaller, more awkward areas. Roller sleeves provide even coverage on smooth to semi-smooth surfaces, such as pre-painted, freshly plastered or lined walls, whilst the high specification synthetic brushes provide steady paint release with minimal brush marks. Extension pole included for hard to reach areas and a 9" deep ridge tray.
b: Brushes Suitable for All Paints & Varnishes
Micropoly Sleeves for Emulsion, undercoat & Eggshell Paint
